Weronika Baszak (born 21 September 2002) is a Polish professional tennis player. Baszak has a career-high ITF combined junior ranking of 39, achieved on 13 January 2020. She made her WTA Tour main-draw debut as a wildcard entrant at the 2021 Poland Open , losing to Aliaksandra Sasnovich in the first round.
